title: Google Trends Scraper
description: Export Google Trends interest over time, interest by region and related queries for any number of keywords and countries, and the Trending now lists.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to check, one per line. Each keyword gets its own record for every location. You can also enter Google topic IDs such as /m/02vqfm.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Countries or regions: codes such as US, GB, US-CA, DE-BY, or names such as Germany. Leave empty or enter Worldwide for the whole world. Every keyword is checked in every location.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: The period of the data, as on the Google Trends website. Google sets the step: minutes for the past hours, hours for 7 days, days up to 9 months, weeks up to 5 years, months beyond.

startDate.title: Start date (custom range)
startDate.description: First day of a custom range, from 2004-01-01. Used when the time range is "Custom dates".

endDate.title: End date (custom range)
endDate.description: Last day of a custom range. Defaults to today.

dailyData.title: Daily data for long periods
dailyData.description: Google gives days only for periods up to about 9 months, weeks up to 5 years and months beyond. Turn this on to get one value per day for any period, also 5 years or since 2004: the Actor reads the period in windows of 250 days and ties every window to Google's weekly or monthly series, so the days stay on one scale. Takes a few more seconds per keyword; no extra charge.

compareOnOneScale.title: Compare all keywords and locations on one scale
compareOnOneScale.description: Off: each keyword and location gets its own 0-100 scale, which shows the shape of its trend best. On: everything shares one 0-100 scale, so you can compare popularity. Google compares at most 5 terms at a time; the Actor has no such limit, and small keywords get decimals (0.37) instead of Google's 0 and "<1".

searchAsTopic.title: Search as Google topics
searchAsTopic.description: Look up each keyword as a Google topic ("Coffee", the drink) instead of the exact search term. A topic counts searches in all languages and spellings and leaves out other meanings.

category.title: Category
category.description: Limit the data to searches in one category. For subcategories, use an explore link with cat=.

includeInterestByRegion.title: Interest by region
includeInterestByRegion.description: Add the interest of every region (states, countries or cities) to each record.

regionResolution.title: Region level
regionResolution.description: Default: countries for worldwide, regions (states) for a country. Cities works everywhere Google has enough data; metro areas (DMA) only in the United States.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Add the top and rising related queries to each record, with flags for queries that do not contain the keyword and for spam.

onlyNewRisingQueries.title: Only new rising queries since the last run
onlyNewRisingQueries.description: For scheduled runs: save a keyword only when it has rising related queries that earlier runs of the same saved task did not see; they are listed in newRisingQueries. The first run saves every keyword and remembers its rising queries. Keywords without anything new are not saved and not charged. Turns on related queries.

exploreUrls.title: Google Trends explore links
exploreUrls.description: Links copied from the Google Trends website, such as https://trends.google.com/trends/explore?date=today%205-y&geo=US&q=tesla,rivian. Each link is repeated exactly: its terms, places, dates, category and search type.

trendingLocations.title: Trending now: locations
trendingLocations.description: Countries or regions for the Trending now lists, such as US, GB or US-NY. Each trending search becomes one record with its search volume, growth, start time and related searches.

trendingHours.title: Trending now: period
trendingHours.description: Searches trending in the past 4 hours, 24 hours, 48 hours or 7 days.

trendingCategories.title: Trending now: categories
trendingCategories.description: Keep only trending searches in these categories. Leave empty for all.

trendingActiveOnly.title: Trending now: active only
trendingActiveOnly.description: Keep only searches that are still trending.

maxTrendingPerLocation.title: Trending now: maximum per location
maxTrendingPerLocation.description: Keep at most this many trending searches per location, in Google's order. 0 keeps all (often 200-500 for 24 hours).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google Trends limits busy addresses. The Actor starts on Apify Proxy, opens a new session when Google limits one, and moves to residential addresses if limits continue.
